title: Third Ziyarat Jamia
intro: The third comprehensive form of ziyarat reported in the source collection, associated with Arafah and visiting the Imams.
description: Read Third Ziyarat Jamia with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text: The third Jamiah - Day of Arafah This form of ziyarah has been reported by Sayyid Ibn Tawus within the supplicatory prayers of the `Arafah Day from Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him. It can be said at visiting any shrine at any time, especially on the `Arafah Day.:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Messenger.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Prophet.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خِيَرَةَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khiyarata allahi min khalqihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s best choice among His creatures
and His trustee on His revelations.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya mawlaya ya amira almu'minina
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Commander of the Faithful.
Peace be upon you, O my master.
You are Allah’s argument against His creatures,
the door to His knowledge,
the successor of His Prophet,
and the vicegerent after him among his nation.
May Allah curse the people who usurped your right
and took your place.
I repudiate them
and their partisans in your presence.
Peace be upon you, O Fatimah the chaste.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا زَيْنَ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O adornment of the women of the worlds.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya binta rasuli rabbi al`alamina
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Messenger of Allah the Lord of the worlds.
May Allah send blessings upon you and him.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O mother of al-Hasan and al-Husayn.
May Allah curse the people who usurped your right

blocks.arabic: وَمَنَعَتْكِ مَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ لَكِ حَلاَلاًَ
blocks.transliteration: wa mana`atki ma ja`alahu allahu laki halalan
blocks.english: and deprived you of that which Allah has deemed lawful to you.

blocks.arabic: أَنَا بَريءٌٌ إِِلَيْكِ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْ شِيعَتِهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: ana bari' ilayki minhum wa min shi`atihim
blocks.english: I repudiate them and their partisans in your presence.
Peace be upon you, O my master
Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan the bright.
Peace be upon you, O my master.
May Allah curse the people who killed you,

blocks.transliteration: wa baya`at fi amrika wa shaya`at
blocks.english: swore allegiance to each other against you, and helped each other against you.

blocks.arabic: أَنَا بَرِيءٌ إِِلَيْكَ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْ شِيعَتِهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: ana bari'un ilayka minhum wa min shi`atihim
blocks.english: I repudiate them and their partisans in your presence.
Peace be upon you, O my master

blocks.arabic: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْحُسَيْنُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: O Abu-`Abdullah al-Husayn the son of `Ali.
Allah’s blessings be upon you,
your father, and your grandfather Muhammad,
may Allah send blessings upon him and his Household.
May Allah curse the people who violated the shedding of your blood.
May Allah curse the people who slew you
and violated the sacredness of your women.

blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ashya`ahum wa atba`ahum
blocks.english: May Allah curse their partisans and followers.
May Allah curse those who paved the way to them
to fight against you.

blocks.arabic: أَنَا بَرِيءٌ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَإِلَيْكَ مِنْهُمْ
blocks.transliteration: ana bari'un ila allahi wa ilayka minhum
blocks.english: I repudiate them in the presence of Allah and you.
Peace be upon you, O my master

blocks.arabic: يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلِيُّ بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.english: Abu-Muhammad `Ali the son of al-Husayn.
Peace be upon you, O my master

blocks.arabic: يَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: Abu-Ja`far Muhammad the son of `Ali.
Peace be upon you, O my master

blocks.arabic: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ جَعْفَرُ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.english: Abu-`Abdullah Ja`far the son of Muhammad.
Peace be upon you, O my master

blocks.arabic: يَا أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ مُوسَىٰ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ
blocks.transliteration: ya aba alhasani musa bna ja`farin
blocks.english: Abu’l-Hasan Musa ibn Ja`far.
Peace be upon you, O my master

blocks.arabic: يَا أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنَ موُسَىٰ
blocks.english: Abu’l-Hasan `Ali ibn Musa.
Peace be upon you, O my master

blocks.arabic: يَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: Abu-Ja`far Muhammad the son of `Ali.
Peace be upon you, O my master

blocks.arabic: يَا أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.english: Abu’l-Hasan `Ali the son of Muhammad.
Peace be upon you, O my master

blocks.arabic: يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْحَسَنُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan the son of `Ali.
Peace be upon you, O my master

blocks.arabic: يَا أَبَا ٱلْقَاسِمِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ ٱلْحَسَنِ
blocks.transliteration: ya aba alqasimi muhammadu bna alhasani
blocks.english: Abu’l-Qasim Muhammad the son of al-Hasan
the patron of the age.
May Allah send blessings upon you
and upon your family, the immaculate and pure.
O my masters, be my intercessors
in the forgiveness of my burdens and sins.

blocks.transliteration: amantu billahi wa bima unzila ilaykum
blocks.english: I believe in Allah in what has been revealed to you.

blocks.transliteration: wa atawala akhirakum bima atawala awwalakum
blocks.english: I swear to the last of you the same loyalty that I swear to the first.
I repudiate all idols, false deities,
Idol Lat, and Idol al-`Uzza.

blocks.arabic: يَا مَوَالِيَّ أَنَا سِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سَالَمَكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: ya mawaliyya ana silmun liman salamakum
blocks.english: O my masters, I am at peace with those who are at peace with you,
I am at war against those who are at war against you,
I am the enemy of those who show enmity towards you,
and I am loyal to those who are loyalists to you
up to the Resurrection Day.

blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu zalimikum wa ghasibikum
blocks.english: May Allah curse those who have wronged you and usurped your rights.

blocks.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أَشْيَاعَهُمْ وَأَتْبَاعَهُمْ وَأَهْلَ مَذْهَبِهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ashya`ahum wa atba`ahum wa ahla madhhabihim
blocks.english: May Allah curse their partisans, followers, and people of their sects.

blocks.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi wa ilaykum minhum
blocks.english: I repudiate them in the presence of Allah and you.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ تیسری زیارت جامعہ کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
